answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work. The gale holds work receipts rather than names, so the reef of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
